comment: Commands that arrive from the command queue. #herecmdmenu queues dosearch(), donull() and dolook() (cmd.c act_on_act()); the inventory item menu queues doorganize(), doswapweapon(), dowieldquiver(), remarm_swapwep() and ia_dotakeoff() with the item's letter (iactions.c itemactions_pushkeys()); #therecmdmenu queues a move. cmd.c rhack() pops each node at 3642-3649 and jumps to do_cmdq_extcmd, where it calls the queued row's ef_funct like any other. The port picked the function for eight queued rows by name in arms of their own; every queued row now takes the one call a key takes. The seed, date and character were chosen for this recipe.
